parts.glance:
Stereo fisheye colour module from Dongguan Hampo Electronic Technology (翰普), with an IMU at about 500 Hz. One recording, solved as stereo and as cam0 alone.

Reprojection median0.27 px
cam0–cam1 baseline65.3 mm
cam0 td−4.78 ms
cam0 lever arm34.4 mm
Reprojection median0.25 px
cam0 td−4.74 ms
cam0 lever arm34.8 mm

Reprojection is how far, in pixels, the detected corners lie from where the solve puts them. td is the camera–IMU time offset, and the lever arm is the camera–IMU position offset.

No independent reference, so this shows consistency between the two solves, not accuracy.

We read these from the calibrated lens fit at the image edges, through the principal point (where the optical axis meets the image). ~ marks an axis past where the corners reached, so the fit is extrapolated there. Past the fit means an edge lies beyond where the fit holds, so we give no value.

parts.limits:
• No independent reference, so this shows consistency between the two solves, not accuracy.
  • The recording is H.264 and the USB-3372 sheet lists MJPG and YUY2, so the exact model stays open.
  • Frame stamps fall about 5.2 ms after mid-exposure, so td here isn't a physical delay.
